messages:
Maya: heads-up — pushed a tiny 'cost-snap' panel to staging. It's a compact per-model view showing token burn, cache-savings, and an inferred unit-cost column. 1-min rollups for now. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Samir: nice. Is sampling turned on for the low-volume tenants? 1-min can look like noise for small models/clients.
Kevin: sampling is disabled by default in this build. My preference was to show raw 1-min then offer a sampled-smoothed line as an overlay. For attribution of cache savings I prototyped a weighted-prefetch heuristic (prefetch credit -> route share).
Lucy: UX question — if we show inferred unit-cost at per-invocation granularity it might trigger freakouts from PMs. Can we add a confidence badge and note about sampling/extrapolation?
Maya: agreed on the badge. Also thinking about a sticky routing toggle in the panel so infra teams can simulate routing policies and see cost delta before rollout.
Samir: that simulation sounds great. Will need to respect quota windows though — a 2 hr sticky override shouldn't bypass tenant quotas.
Kevin: for the simulation backend I'm returning a tiny diff proto. Example query we use to compute per-model token burn (staging):
```sql
SELECT model, minute_bucket, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cache_savings) AS cache_savings
FROM token_events_staging
WHERE minute_bucket >= now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY model, minute_bucket;
```
Also sampling param in the service config looks like: `{\"sampling_rate\": 0.02, \"extrapolate\": true}` in the PR.
Lucy: pinging the design doc: can we show three columns: raw cost, cache-offset, and conservative-estimate? Conservative-estimate = raw - min(cache_offset, 0.8*raw) so we avoid negative dips.
Maya: good call. Will add conservative-estimate and a tooltip: "conservative = clip(raw - cache_offset, 20%..100%)".
ops-bot: deploy succeeded for snapshots-api v2 -> staging (build 4821) :white_check_mark:
Samir: quick ask for telemetry — include the signal that marks 'simulated routing' so we can filter those runs out of billing projections. Add `simulated=true` label to trace.
Kevin: we'll emit `trace.labels.simulated` and a `sampling.applied` bool. Also expect some lag in cache-credit reconciliation (~3-5 min), flag that in the panel footer.
Lucy: can we add a short inline explainer next to the unit-cost header like "Unit cost is estimate; see tooltip" and a link to the methodology doc. PMs will appreciate clarity.
Maya: totally. I'll add the badge, the tooltip copy, and a link to the doc. After QA we can roll to canary with the sticky-routing simulation off by default.
Samir: sgtm. Opening a tiny follow-up PR to add the `simulated` label to the router shim.
Kevin: leaving a note here — when we enable sampling for low-volume models, include a per-model sample rate override. We don't want one global rate.
Maya: ok thanks all, will update staging with the UX tweaks and post a short demo in #eng-platform tomorrow.
